input: const r=await tools.exec_command({cmd:"python3 -c 'import json; p=\".ai/task/batch-f740e6898e8b430ca79f/SURFACE-SCREEN-ENVELOPE-lane-000-1.json\"; x=json.load(open(p)); issues={2:\"原文说每天拖起疲惫的身体开始无尽狩猎；译文写成不知疲倦、无时无刻狩猎，疲惫与每天的含义被反转或改写。\",4:\"原文只有‘梦着我的梦’，译文加入‘你的梦’，改变了所指。\",15:\"原文是使用技能不消耗资源；译文限定为不消耗能量，缩窄了资源范围。\",16:\"原文 cunning 指狡黠、机敏；译文写成‘灵巧’，变成身体敏捷。\",17:\"诗句‘Once flowers rose to reach the sky’被译成‘曾经炽热的复仇火焰染红天空’，把花朵误写成复仇火焰。\"}; out={\"candidate_identity\":x[\"candidate_identity\"],\"contract\":\"translation_surface_screen_v1\",\"results\":[dict({\"entry_revision_identity\":e[\"entry_revision_identity\"]},**({\"observation\":issues[i],\"verdict\":\"ISSUE\"} if i in issues else {\"verdict\":\"OK\"})) for i,e in enumerate(x[\"payload\"][\"entries\"])]}; print(json.dumps(out,ensure_ascii=False,sort_keys=True,separators=(\",\",\":\")))'","workdir":"/workspace/tome4-chinese-translation","sandbox_permissions":"require_escalated","justification":"May I read the specified envelope once more to generate the required ordered canonical JSON response?","max_output_tokens":10000});text(r.output)
